title.narrative: Indonesia HIV Response: Eliminating the AIDS Epidemic in Indonesia by 2030

description.narrative: Indonesia - HIV - Directorate General of Disease Prevention and Control, Ministry of Health of The Republic of Indonesia - MOH. This program has the following goals: Elimination HIV and AIDS as a public health risk through achieving the global 95-95-95 targets by 2030. The objectives of this program are: Prevention of new infection by expanding PrEP for KP ( MSM, FSW and TG) in at least 160 districts by 2026. To achieve 95% PLHIV know status by the end of 2026. To achieve 75% PLHIV on treatment by the end of 2026. To achieve 68% PLHIV on ART had virally supressed by the end 2026. Increase HIV testing among TB patients and ART coverage among TB-HIV patients by end of 2026. To achieve the reduction of the stigma and discrimination to the KPs and PLHIV at the health care settings by the end of 2026
